# crabbox-cli

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Binary | `/usr/local/bin/crabbox` |
| Source | pinned `opencharly/crabbox` COMMIT (`CRABBOX_COMMIT` var), built with `go build -trimpath ./cmd/crabbox` |
| Version | the pinned commit, injected with `-X github.com/openclaw/crabbox/internal/cli.version=<commit>` |
| Install | ONE `command:` step: curl the commit's tarball → extract → `go build` (CGO disabled) → discard the tree in the same RUN |
| Requires | `layer-golang` (the Go toolchain), `layer-gh` (git), `layer-ssh-client` (ssh/ssh-keygen), rsync + curl packages |
| Alias | `crabbox` (wrapper runs in-box via `charly alias`) |
| Config sibling | `crabbox-containerd-config` — `provider: containerd` + `containerd.image` |

## What it installs

A single static Go binary BUILT from the `opencharly/crabbox` commit pinned in
`CRABBOX_COMMIT`. The fetch and the build are ONE `command:` step: the tarball is
downloaded, extracted to a temp dir, compiled, and the temp dir is removed by a
`trap` in the same RUN — the source never becomes image content. The source build is not an optimization: no `openclaw/crabbox`
release carries the `containerd` SSH-lease provider, so a downloaded 0.79.0
asserts a CLI that cannot lease on containerd. The version string IS the commit,
so `crabbox --version` names the source the binary came from. Prerequisites for
the CLI's lease/sync machinery (git, ssh, ssh-keygen, rsync, curl) come from
composed candies/packages — never re-shipped.

## Verification

The candy's `plan:` ships deterministic `check:` steps: the binary lands at
`/usr/local/bin/crabbox`, `crabbox --version` reports the pinned commit,
`crabbox providers` lists the `containerd` provider, `crabbox providers describe
containerd` succeeds, and the config candy's rendered file is read back by
`crabbox config show`. The repo's bed `check-crabbox-cli` runs all of them in a
disposable container. `crabbox doctor` is deliberately not an image check: it
judges the LIVE provider's prerequisites (daemon/broker), which a build container
does not have — a venue's readiness belongs to a live bed (the `crabbox:` verb's
`containerd-preflight`).

## Provider surface (no cloud credentials)

| Provider | Notes |
|----------|-------|
| `containerd` (alias `nerdctl`) | SSH leases as containers on a local or remote containerd daemon (crun/krun/runc runtimes, overlayfs/native/fuse-overlayfs/btrfs snapshotters) |
| `local-container` (aliases `docker`/`container`/`local-docker`) | SSH leases as a local container (Podman/Docker); sync/run/logs/artifacts + `--desktop`/`--browser` capabilities |
| `ssh` (`static`/`static-ssh`) | existing machines |
| `external` (`exec-provider`) | an executable implementing the crabbox provider protocol |
| cloud (aws/azure/gcp/hetzner/daytona/…) | direct modes with operator credentials; documented-only |

Opt out of the explicit lease hostname for runtimes that share the
host UTS namespace via `localContainer.noHostname: true` in
`~/.config/crabbox/config.yaml` (or
`CRABBOX_LOCAL_CONTAINER_NO_HOSTNAME=1`) — a fixed lease ID conflicts when the
setting changes between acquisitions.

## The containerd config candy

`crabbox-containerd-config` is a SEPARATE candy, referenced by path
(`@github.com/opencharly/layer-crabbox/crabbox-containerd-config:<tag>`). The root
ref's STRING is unchanged, but the resolved candy is named `layer-crabbox` (the
ref leaf), so a consumer that composes it by NAME follows the rename. It renders
`~/.config/crabbox/config.yaml` through the `config:` verb, validated against
plugin-egress's `crabbox-yaml` schema:

```yaml
provider: containerd
containerd:
    image: ghcr.io/opencharly/pod-crabbox:2026.293.1655
```

`CRABBOX_CONTAINERD_IMAGE` is the lease image. A host that does not have it fails
the lease with that exact ref; the `crabbox:` verb's `containerd-preflight`
reports it as a visible SKIP before anything is leased.

## Install on a dev host / box

```bash
charly deploy add crabbox crabbox --target local   # installs /usr/local/bin/crabbox
charly alias install <box>                        # alias wrapper
crabbox providers describe containerd             # the source build's provider
crabbox doctor --provider containerd              # provider selection + host prerequisites
```
